stories.title: Wales selection and Borders League podium for Deestriders RC
stories.summary: Deestriders runner Angela Deeley has represented Wales at the Masters International match against England, held at the Bideford 10k. Her selection is one of several headline results from a packed spell for the Deeside-based club, with members posting times across fell races, road events and trail runs in north Wales and north west England. stories.title: North Wales Police recorded 530 non-crime hate incidents in 35 months under code now being scrapped

stories.title: Flintshire speed cameras issued more than 20,000 fines in 2025
stories.summary: Eight of the ten busiest speed cameras in North Wales are sited in Flintshire, with a single camera on the A5104 at Pontybodkin issuing more than 4,300 fixed penalty notices to drivers in 2025. stories.summary: Opponents of plans to close four Catholic schools in Flintshire to create a 3-18 super-school say it undermines the new Welsh Government’s commitment to strengthen Welsh culture. stories.title: Flintshire leader Dave Hughes eyes re-election at last AGM before polls
stories.summary: Councillor Dave Hughes will ask Flintshire County Council to back him as leader for another year on Tuesday, at the chamber’s last annual meeting before next May’s elections.
